data.one_liner: Customizable persistent bottom navigation bar with 17 prebuilt styles and separate tab stacks.
data.what_it_does: Provides a persistent bottom navigation bar widget that maintains separate navigation stacks across tabs when switching. It includes 17 prebuilt bar styles, supports custom styling, and integrates with go_router and Android back button handling. It also enables scroll-to-top on double tap, animated icons, and hiding the bar during scroll.
use_when: You need a bottom navigation bar that preserves the navigation history of each tab independently.
You want prebuilt, styled navigation bar animations without designing custom bar components from scratch.
You need features like hiding navigation bars on scroll, animated tab icons, or scroll-to-top behavior.
avoid_when: You only require Flutter's standard BottomNavigationBar or NavigationBar without nested navigators.
Your routing architecture already manages stateful nested navigation exclusively via standard go_router StatefulShellRoute.
strengths: Offers 17 prebuilt, animated navigation bar styles ready out-of-the-box.
Maintains individual navigation stacks per tab without discarding state.
Supports integration with go_router for declarative routing.
weaknesses: Replaces standard Scaffold page structures and requires adapting page layouts around PersistentTabView.
Tight dependency on go_router version bumps can lead to dependency constraints across major Flutter versions.
data.setup_notes: Works as a top-level container similar to Scaffold; avoid nesting inside Scaffold.body.
